integrity: The claims are mathematical consequences of a full algebraic proof. Two standalone checkers and their outputs are included. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only cycle lengths n=2^r >= 4 in characteristic two are covered.
Finite-rank tests are supplementary; the all-n and all-q conclusions rely on the explicit polynomial-module proof.
Macfarlane (2004) full text was inaccessible; an equivalent or stronger antecedent in unindexed literature is possible.
title: Pendant memory creates a threefold wave clock on dyadic sunlet graphs
